content:
Welcome back to this week's Apple Certified Refurbished Store update. This week's featured products include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, allowing you to purchase Apple products from Apple's official website at prices as low as 15% off.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality guaranteed, even better prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased separately
  • Refurbished products are not eligible for engraving or gift wrapping services

We track every addition and removal from the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, so you don't have to check it yourself. Inventory changes rapidly, and we hope this report gives you an idea of what products are currently available so you can snag your desired item before it sells out.

Mac

In terms of price, the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain the most attractive options. Both are perfect for users entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time, or upgrading to a product equipped with Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago, we first reported that the Studio Display XDR had become available through the Apple Refurbished Store. Inventory changes are often fleeting, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and an adjustable tilt and height stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and an adjustable tilt and height stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The ever-popular base model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, and the higher-end model with Ethernet is also continuously available. The base model usually sells out quickly, so if you want one, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want to follow suit, the Apple Refurbished Store has several very affordable options this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799)

As always, you can stay on top of the latest Apple deals all week long through 9to5Tocks.
